normalized_hypothesis: 6h hybrid baseline sweep before candidate tuning

change_summary: Set nav2_params_camera MPPI CostCritic cost_weight from 3.2 to 5.0
conclusion: Discard: removed obstacle contact and improved clearance, but stalled much earlier on ramp_turns, so CostCritic-only increase is too conservative.
hypothesis: Increase MPPI CostCritic weight to reduce ramp-turn obstacle clipping without changing global topology
normalized_hypothesis: increase mppi costcritic weight to reduce ramp turn obstacle clipping without changing global topology
retry_rule: Do not retry as a CostCritic-only increase; revisit only as part of a paired path-following or goal-handling change.

change_summary: Set nav2_params_camera MPPI wz_std from 0.45 to 0.65
conclusion: Discard: first run improved distance/no contact but second run crossed right_boundary_2 and slowed badly, so wider angular noise is unsafe/noisy.
hypothesis: Increase MPPI angular sampling to improve ramp-turn progress without changing cost topology
normalized_hypothesis: increase mppi angular sampling to improve ramp turn progress without changing cost topology
retry_rule: Do not retry wz_std 0.65 alone; revisit angular exploration only with stronger line clearance or reduced path/goal churn.

change_summary: Set GoalBender and IsForwardBlocked angle_threshold from 1.57 rad to 2.35 rad
conclusion: Discard: ramp distance improved and tight_gaps passed, but compact_baseline regressed to blocking_stop_over_60s, so the relaxed forward-block threshold is too broad.
hypothesis: Relax BT forward-blocked angle threshold so sharp legal ramp turns do not trigger GoalBender recovery
normalized_hypothesis: relax bt forward blocked angle threshold so sharp legal ramp turns do not trigger goalbender recovery
retry_rule: Do not retry 2.35 rad globally; revisit only as a course/geometry-aware GoalBender condition or a narrower threshold with compact regression tests.

change_summary: Set GoalBender and IsForwardBlocked angle_threshold from 1.57 rad to 2.00 rad
conclusion: Discard: ramp distance improved but remained too slow; compact_baseline regressed to blocking_stop_over_60s, so even 2.0 rad is too broad globally.
hypothesis: Use a narrower 2.0 rad BT forward-block threshold to reduce false ramp recovery without compact regression
normalized_hypothesis: use a narrower 2 0 rad bt forward block threshold to reduce false ramp recovery without compact regression

change_summary: Set global_costmap inflation_layer inflation_radius from 0.85 to 0.65

normalized_hypothesis: reduce global pca obstacle soft inflation radius to keep ramp turn paths inside lane without changing hard keepout
retry_rule: Do not reduce global cone inflation below 0.85 alone; revisit only with a compensating local/controller or waypoint strategy.

normalized_hypothesis: strengthen camera line soft keepout while preserving 5 ft tight gap traversal
retry_rule: Do not widen line inscribed_radius to 0.15 with cost_scaling 2.5; future clearance work needs adaptive/contextual costs or a smaller isolated change.
